items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names describe what things do (encryptWriter, ensureHeader, writeChunk, verifyTrailingHMAC, decodeAndValidateKey). Exported constants and functions have doc comments, and the chunk write steps are commented. Formatting matches the repo's existing gofmt'd style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Leftover wrapper `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` is dead code. Unrequested UnmarshalYAML alias parsing (key_source/key-source). save() calls Validate, then LoadKey runs validateFields again. storage.PathGenerator is wrapped with a hardcoded false instead of updating its callers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Key length is checked at both boundaries, errors are wrapped with %w around ErrInvalidKey, and Close is idempotent and keeps the first error. Salt length and empty passphrase are checked. Minor: readHeader drops the real read error and always reports io.ErrUnexpectedEOF.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The required signature changes are done and unencrypted output and filenames are unchanged. Extras: UnmarshalYAML accepts new snake/kebab YAML keys, the unexported validate() is kept, and PathGenerator passes `fileutil.EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)` instead of updating its callers.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
